summary: JBS N.V., a Netherlands-based meat packing company, filed a Form 6-K reporting a routine dividend payment approved by its Board of Directors. The dividend is USD 1.00 per common share, payable on June 17, 2026, to shareholders of record as of May 18, 2026. The filing is an ordinary current report on Form 6-K (the foreign private issuer equivalent of a Form 8-K) and does not relate to a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return (e.g., special dividend or buyback), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The dividend is a standard capital allocation event without unusual terms or strategic significance.
